svg.title: Tensor and token route — every fused stage — window_block_c256_input_view_fp8
svg.desc: The complete sequence of model operations fused by this public entry, with per-stage tensor dimensions and storage. Matrix grids are schematic tensor tiles, not literal scalar counts. Shared, register and global boundaries differ across entries and precisions.
svg.text: Tensor and token route — every fused stage
Input: channel planes → native A gather → Output: native packed tiles
Orange follows one selected token within each operation. The spatial-boundary map resolves pooling and repetition where present.
branch panels → dense mix → published Z
8 heads; each reads all C256; Q/K norm
one score row per query; learned bias
row sum over 64 keys; publish P
shared attended heads → C256; scaled residual
Lifetimes follow the arrows; blocks labeled “registers” are not intermediate global tensors.
Source order, residual inputs, normalization axes and precision changes are detailed in the adjacent walkthrough.
